caption: Temo riverfront, Bosa
composition: Colorful riverside houses under Malaspina Castle · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The view runs along the Temo from the near bank, the row of pastel riverfront houses — ochre, coral, green, and cream — lining the left with their reflections doubling in the glassy water. The ruined Malaspina Castle crowns the scrubby hill at the center right, mirrored faintly below it, and soft morning mist drifts over the river's far reach. At 08:52 the light is gentle and golden, and the water is perfectly still.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Bosa under morning light
